title: Conflict Detail Output Artifact (C5, s104-m03)
description: Single-entity deep breakdown artifact produced by the conflict-detail emitter. Composable with s103-m01 review.resolve and s104-m02 review-queue: queue gives the list of items needing review; conflict-detail gives the WHY for a specific item; review.resolve applies policy to resolve. Surfaces FULL confidence signals (not top-N), evidence gaps (low signals OR missing evidence_refs OR missing confidence_decomposition), and entity context (projection variants, brand overlay, schema.org URL).

flaggedForReview.description: True when needsReview(score, reviewThreshold) — score < threshold OR tier=unknown.

signals.description: FULL set of signals from oods.confidence_decomposition.signals — NOT truncated. Empty when confidence_decomposition is absent. Sorted by score ascending so the weakest signals lead.

gaps.description: Evidence gaps detected on this entity. Three sources: 'signal' (signal.score < evidenceGapThreshold), 'evidence_refs' (evidence_refs[] empty or absent), 'confidence_decomposition' (no confidence_decomposition emitted). Order: confidence_decomposition gap first (if any), then evidence_refs gap (if any), then signal gaps (ascending by signal.score).

threshold.description: Effective evidenceGapThreshold the signal fell under.

ConflictDetailContext.description: Optional entity context. Each field is mirrored verbatim from the source entity when present and omitted otherwise — additionalProperties:false makes presence/absence observable to gate consumers.

projectionVariants.description: Mirror of oods.projection_variants[].surface — variant names only, not full slot definitions.

schemaorg.description: Mirror of entity.context.schemaorg when present (s102-m01 content domain pack convention).

sourceManifest.description: Identifier of the manifest the entity came from (options.sourceManifestId).
